subject: Your payment on Abundance failed
previewText: Your deposit to your Abundance account was unsuccessful. Please try again

fields.heading: Payment failed
fields.body:
Hi {user_first_name},

Unfortunately, there has been a problem with your payment. We have the following information from our payment provider:

{result_code}:{result_message}

No money has been taken and any reserved investments will be not be confirmed until you make a new payment.

If you have any questions or issues, please do not hesitate to contact us us at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666.
